description: Tiered context escalation: read only packages that match task language. Do not load every doc by default.
content_policy: Repo summaries stay functional/process-only; no people rosters. Secrets stay on Confluence, not in JSON.

tiers.name: session_anchor
tiers.when: Substantive QA or multi-step work; always skim T0 first.
tiers.skip_deep_read_when: Trivial, explicitly local edits (e.g. scratch only under automation/temp/) with no product/QA/process context.

match_any_package.mcp_hint: Confluence: CT home (342168339) for space entry; XT home (402589545) for upstream platform, boards, demo hosts. Strip contacts/people from summaries.
Confluence: QAPORTAL page Corner (497097273) and descendants only—not the whole QA space unless user widens scope.

Structured env URLs, Jira project index, Stash repo ladder, QAPORTAL/CT/XT scope recap—do not invent hosts or branches. Gaps: confluence_search scoped (ancestor=497097273 or space CT/XT) then confluence_get_page; Stash: bitbucket_list_repositories / browse / get_file; bitbucket_search_code may 404 on stash—use epic-prep 5b browse fallback; never copy credentials from Confluence into repo files.

All tools in the exposed set are read-only. Stash: project_key+repo_slug from PROJECT_KEY/repo_slug; prefer list/browse/get before bitbucket_search_code; search may 404 while browse works—see docs/mcp-atlassian-tools.md.

match_any_package.note: Open only the ref that matches the deliverable (e.g. test draft norms/schema vs Smart Checklist/coverage vs DR), not necessarily all three.

match_any_package.mcp_hint: Use Figma MCP if enabled in Cursor; paste figma.com links with node-id. Access matches the OAuth user’s file permissions.

automation/tools/yogi-tool/yogi_resolve.py for URL/page_id; yogi_snippet.py (REST + extract) for small snippet_text—avoid pasting full confluence_get_page bodies per tag. --storage-file accepts metadata.content.value (MCP). Extractor disambiguates duplicate keys (DEFINITION vs LINK). --follow --cookie --snippet for one-shot; exit 3 if key missing in storage.

Epic artifact: epics/<EPIC-KEY>/<EPIC-KEY>-ref.json; schema_version 3 adds sources.bitbucket_repo, implementation.hits (EPIC-PREP step 5b). Optional EPIC-PREP repo=; repo resolution: trigger > prior ref > docs/project.json bitbucket.default_repo. step 2b client_shell_impact (Corner Trader vs Adaptive per qa-project.json). requirements[]: snippet_status + snippet_failure_reason when snippet missing. epic-prep uses epics/<KEY>/temp/ then delete temp/. Yogi: yogi_resolve + yogi_snippet. Bitbucket: map Stash BRO/xt → project_key=BRO, repo_slug=xt before bitbucket_search_code; capped search; on HTTP 404 for /rest/api/1.0/search use step 5b browse_directory fallback (~3 calls) per epic-prep.md. XT: cap ~8 xt_refs, XT home 402589545—no full page bodies in ref.

Requires -ref.json with client_shell_impact. Phase 7 merges epic-ref implementation.hits (epic_prep), dedupes, renumbers impl-001…, then Bitbucket search from matrix/snippets when repo resolved (COVERAGE repo= overrides ref and project.json bitbucket.default_repo); same Stash MCP mapping + search-404 browse fallback as epic-prep step 5b. calculation_contract ladders, out_of_epic fork not in body, evidence-gated dimensions, per-surface lines (Adaptive when affected), epic_verification_focus + verification_role. focus= optional. Durable: -coverage.json + .md; delete epics/<KEY>/temp/ after run.

Jira jira_get_issue + jira_search (CRTQA, CRTBL, SUPXT, CAN per qa-project). Loads -ref.json and -coverage.json when on disk; emits -analysis.json + .md; optional append Known issue > to checks[].detail_lines with dedupe; include_closed=yes for closed regression anchors. delete epics/<KEY>/temp/ after run.

Requires -coverage.json. Phase 8a: bundle shells only. Phase 8b: one subprocess per bundle (e.g. Task generalPurpose)—MUST NOT one-shot all draft prose; prefer temp/test-prep-draft-<bundle_id>.json merge. Jira steps only from fetched fields. Emits -tests.json + -tests.md; authoring.subprocess_completed per bundle; no /temp/ in durable JSON. map_only=yes skips 8b. delete epics/<KEY>/temp/ after run.

Optional; requires -tests.json from TEST-PREP. user-mcp-playwright + optional postgres-ctqa (tunnel up). One subprocess per bundle for spec materialization; epics/<KEY>/tests/*.spec.ts + -test-exec.json; temp/test-exec-* then delete epics/<KEY>/temp/. No console/SSH/webbroker-only setup—blocked bundles unless include_blocked=yes.

No MCP. Git only: checkout release, merge origin/develop or origin/main (source=), tiers A-D scrub, write docs/public-export-manifest.json on release only, .agents/ per dotagentsprotocol.com, V1 rg blocklist then V2 worktree re-run. version= sets semver; else patch bump from manifest. Never commit scrub on main/develop. Ephemeral automation/temp/public-scrub/ then delete.

No Atlassian MCP. develop/main only—not release. scope=pipelines|prompts|templates|tools|mcp|full. Tiers T0-T6: router + harness-map + AGENTS + README + HOW-TO + qa-artifacts + prompts + epics templates + automation/tools + MCP (postgres-ctqa) doc parity in HOW-TO/AGENTS/README/tunnel README + rules inventory + harness-maintenance rg. V1: HOW-TO still contains postgres-ctqa JSON snippet; no committed .cursor/mcp/ folder. Ephemeral automation/temp/sync/ then delete. Complements PUBLIC-SCRUB (release only).

tiers.name: external_truth
tiers.use: user-mcp-atlassian; optional Figma MCP (Cursor-configured) for figma.com URLs; optional postgres-ctqa MCP when .cursor/mcp.json or global ~/.cursor/mcp.json includes postgres-ctqa and tunnel is up; optional user-mcp-playwright for TEST-EXEC UI steps
tiers.when: Jira issues, Confluence bodies, search, or live boards—after T0/T1 as needed. For Figma frame/layer links, use Figma MCP when installed (automation/docs/figma-mcp.md). For CTQA PostgreSQL exploration or TEST-EXEC DB checks, use postgres-ctqa after tunnel (automation/tools/tunnel/ctqa_pg.py) and Cursor MCP (gitignored .cursor/mcp.json or global)—see .cursor/HOW-TO.md (MCP — PostgreSQL), automation/tools/tunnel/README.md.
tiers.mcp_scope: Scope Atlassian searches using docs/project.json, docs/qa-project.json, and docs/corner-platform-map.json mcp_scope_recap (CT, XT, QAPORTAL subtree rooted at 497097273).

rules: Do not read all JSON and ref files for every task. Match the user's language to T1 match_any_package entries; when one package is the clear best fit, read primarily its read[] list.

If the user message names a Jira issue key in Corner families (CRT, CRTQA, CRTBL, XT, SUPXT, CAN), use user-mcp-atlassian (jira_get_issue or jira_search) to fetch it before substantive ticket-specific prose—do not invent fields or comments.

When multiple T1 packages could apply, also read docs/corner-platform-map.json if the task involves where to reproduce (environment, hostname, database name, WebBroker vs dxTrade5 vs Adaptive), which Jira project or dashboard, or which Stash repo—unless scope is unrelated (e.g. Figma-only).
After T1, use MCP for authoritative Atlassian content; do not invent ticket or page text.
Never copy passwords or secrets from Confluence into repo files.
When adding new durable docs or paths, update AGENTS.md, README.md, and this map per harness-maintenance rule.
